clips.title: The story
paras: Follow That Kobold! is an Alliance quest in Northshire Valley dealing with a bizarre theft from the local mines. A kobold has fled with a sack of Brother Paxton's books, prompting the abbey to recruit the dwarven hunter trainer Tordrin Sternblade to assist in tracking the thief.

Just when the workers and clerics of Northshire Abbey believed the vermin problem in the mines was under control, an unusual report arrived from Kelsey: a lone kobold was spotted fleeing the tunnels hauling a heavy sack of books. The stolen volumes belong to Brother Paxton, who urgently requires their return to the abbey's collection.

Tracking a nimble subterranean scavenger through the wooded grounds of Northshire requires specialized skill. To find the thief, adventurers are directed behind the abbey to the stables to seek out Tordrin Sternblade, a dwarven Hunter trainer newly arrived from Ironforge who possesses the wilderness knowledge needed to pick up the scent.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.
Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.
